title: Ensure AAP Inventory with Hosts
description: Ensures that an AAP organization and inventory exist, then adds any missing hosts to the inventory, reporting per-host outcomes.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: aap_gateway_ip
parameters.description: IP address or hostname of the AAP controller.

parameters.name: aap_username
parameters.description: Username to authenticate with the AAP controller.

parameters.name: aap_password
parameters.description: Password to authenticate with the AAP controller.

parameters.name: organization_name
parameters.description: Name of the organization to ensure exists.

parameters.name: inventory_name
parameters.description: Name of the inventory to ensure exists within the organization.

parameters.name: host_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of host names that should be in the inventory.

playbook_output.description: Structured result describing the organization, inventory, and host outcomes.

fields.name: existing_hosts
fields.description: Hosts that already existed in the inventory before the playbook ran.

fields.name: added_hosts
fields.description: Hosts that were successfully added by this playbook.

fields.name: failed_hosts
fields.description: Hosts that could not be added.

steps.name: Look up organization
steps.function: Query the AAP controller API for an organization matching the given name.

steps.name: Does the organization already exist?
steps.function: Branch on whether an organization with the given name was found.
steps.condition: The organization lookup returned at least one result.

steps.name: Create the organization
steps.function: Create the organization using the idempotent ansible.controller.organization module.

steps.name: Look up inventory
steps.function: Query the AAP controller API for an inventory with the given name inside the organization.

steps.name: Does the inventory already exist?
steps.function: Branch on whether a matching inventory was found.
steps.condition: The inventory lookup returned at least one result.

steps.name: Create the inventory
steps.function: Create the inventory using the idempotent ansible.controller.inventory module.

steps.name: Split host list
steps.function: Convert the comma-separated host_list string into a proper list of host names.

steps.name: Look up existing hosts in inventory
steps.function: Fetch the list of hosts already present in the inventory using the AAP API.

steps.name: Compute hosts to add
steps.function: Build the list of hosts that need to be added by subtracting existing hosts from desired hosts.

computations._existing_host_names: Extract the 'name' field of each entry in _existing_hosts.
computations._hosts_to_add: From _desired_hosts, remove any name that appears in _existing_hosts (using _existing_host_names).

steps.name: Add missing hosts
steps.function: Loop over _hosts_to_add and add each host to the inventory using ansible.controller.host with ignore_errors enabled, capturing per‑item results.

steps.name: Summarize host results
steps.function: Categorize the per‑host results into added and failed lists.

computations._added_hosts: List of hostnames from _add_results where the item was successfully added.
computations._failed_hosts: List of hostnames from _add_results where the item failed.

steps.name: Emit result block
steps.function: Print the structured result containing organization, inventory, and host outcomes.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Pre-checks
phases.description: Validate organization existence and create it if missing.

phases.name: Inventory setup
phases.description: Ensure the inventory exists inside the organization.

phases.name: Host preparation
phases.description: Parse the desired host list and discover which hosts are already present.

phases.name: Host addition & summary
phases.description: Add missing hosts with per‑item error handling and categorize the outcomes.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Emit the complete structured result to the caller.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
